verdict.rationale: RevenueCat stores customer purchase and subscription data, so controlling retention and deletion is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents retention settings, customer deletion, or data-erasure endpoints. Scheduled data exports and Secret-key API actions such as refunds and promotional grants are adjacent features and do not deliver retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
